prompt:
You write realistic phone-call wording for a clinic scheduling test set.
For each scenario below, write what the caller would actually say for each listed field, the way a
note-taking assistant would record the caller's own words for that field (a short phrase, not a full
sentence). Vary the style across scenarios: casual, terse, older caller, non-native speaker, rambling.
Use only the facts in the scenario; do not add any other doctor, clinic or service. When the scenario
says the caller does not know the medical name, describe the need the way a layperson would, without
naming a medical specialty or a type of appointment. Do not use tools or open files; answer directly.

Return ONLY a JSON array, one object per scenario: {"id": ..., "<field>": "...", ...} with exactly the
fields listed for that scenario.

Scenarios:
- id h5-25: Existing patient who sees the hormone specialist here regularly and wants to book their usual follow-up. They do not say what it is for. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
- id h5-26: Existing patient whose doctor ordered a scan of their lower back. They do not know what kind of scan it is and do not name one. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
- id h5-27: Existing patient who found a lump in her breast; her doctor ordered imaging of the breast, but she does not know which kind and does not name one. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
- id h5-28: Existing patient whose mother went blind from high pressure inside her eyes; their regular doctor wants them to have their eye pressure checked by an eye specialist. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
- id h5-29: Existing patient who has been doing weekly exercise sessions for their back with a physical therapist at another place and wants to continue those weekly sessions here; they call it 'rehab'. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
- id h5-x01: A brand-new patient who has never been seen here has a pacemaker and needs it checked; an outside doctor referred them. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
- id h5-x02: A brand-new patient who has never been seen here wants the skin tests that show exactly what they are allergic to; an outside doctor referred them. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
- id h5-x03: Existing patient with no referral whose shoulder has hurt for months and who wants to see an orthopedist; they say 'orthopedist'. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
- id h5-x04: A brand-new patient who just moved here, is about twelve weeks pregnant and needs a doctor here to look after the pregnancy. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
- id h5-x05: A brand-new patient whose outside doctor found an overactive thyroid and referred them to a specialist for it; they mention the thyroid. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words
- id h5-p01: Existing patient who wants a sick visit with a specific doctor. Fields: provider_phrase = how the caller names the doctor: Dr. Nguyen, and that it is the internal medicine doctor (no first name)
- id h5-p02: Existing patient who wants a annual wellness visit with a specific doctor. Fields: provider_phrase = how the caller names the doctor: Dr. Sato, and that it is the internal medicine doctor (no first name)
